name: Konno Naomichi
source:
He is a doctor who specializes in treating a rare diseases like arrested development caused by psychological trauma.

He rarely opens up and gives the impression of being stoic, he is often cold to those around him because of this.

He is also constantly questioning himself as a doctor. Perhaps the person who was saved the most by meeting Kanata and Kurumi is the doctor himself.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=69721&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
